name: vibeaudit-tests
comment: This file exists so that `node --test test/` works on every supported Node version.
Node >= 22.6 resolves a positional test-runner argument as a glob and then loads
the matched path as a module. A bare directory cannot be executed, but a directory
with a package.json `main` entry can - Node resolves it to test/suite.js, which
On Node 20 the same command searches the directory recursively and runs the test
files directly, so the same tests run (once more than once, because suite.js also
imports them - the tests are written to be independent, so that is harmless).
Only .sql / .ts / .env files live in test/fixtures, so the Node 20 recursive search
never tries to execute a fixture as a test.
